segments.name: Electronics-focused e-retailer
segments.description: Sells consumer electronics and technology products online to consumers and businesses, and provides marketplace and e-commerce services to brands and sellers.
segments.evidence: The Company considers itself to be operating within one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for technology products bought directly; Marketplace sellers pay commissions on their sales; customers and sellers pay for services such as third-party logistics and advertising.
revenueModel.evidence: On our Newegg Marketplace, third-party sellers offer their products to our customers through our platforms and pay us commissions on their sales.
